svg.text: Declared but not selectable by 3-bit iDelay.
All DFFs: rising-edge iClk, active-low asynchronous clear iRsn. Input MUX writes zero for invalid input.
Data and valid taps are separate named MUX inputs, not electrically shorted together. Selectable delays: 1…7.
Source-derived RTL structure. Not a post-synthesis FPGA technology netlist; no physical resource count is claimed.
